<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak at m/z 100.0524 corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]+. Subtracting the proton mass (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈99.045 Da. The formula C₅H₇O₂ has a calculated monoisotopic mass of 99.0446 Da, matching the observed mass within <1 mDa. The relative intensity of the M+1 peak (~5.6 %) aligns with the expected 13C contribution from five carbons (~5.5 %). Thus the molecular formula that best fits the data is C5H7O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C5H7O2</final_answer>
